text:
Most people use ChatGPT wrong by doing all the thinking themselves.

Try this simple trick: make the AI interview you before it writes anything.

How to use it:
• Paste your task and add: "Ask me 5 quick questions one by one to get all context."
• Answer each question in short, bulleted points.
• Let it generate the final draft using your exact details.

The bottom line:
You spend 1 minute answering questions instead of 20 minutes fixing a bad first draft.

Have you tried making AI ask you questions yet?
